summary.intent: Condense ADR 007 and ADR 008 in the repo to match the shorter 011-017 ADR layout, delegated to a subagent. Separately, the session modified sentinel gate/exit-gate and evidence reference files.
summary.outcome: A subagent rewrote ADR 007 (926 to 602 words) and 008 (786 to 466 words) on branch worktree-agent-a80a839ee8100b713 (commit 88b7eae5), merged origin/feat/gate-round-limits cleanly, and passed `just check` and the ADR style script. Nothing was pushed.

repo: ADRs 011-017 are the target layout for decision records; `python3 scripts/check-adr-style.py` verifies they read as decisions (17 records read as decisions).
`just check` is the repo's main validation command and exited 0 after the ADR rewrites.
docs/adr/README.md has index rows for 007 and 008, including 007's 'Umbrella-brand clause superseded by 010'; these were left unchanged.
Plugin sources live in plugins/, with generated or harness copies in harnesses/codex/plugins and dist/codex/plugins, so sentinel gate changes touch multiple mirrored files.
No ADR-evidence entry exists in docs/evaluations/frontend-design/IMPLEMENTATION-LOG.md for ADR 007 or 008, so commit hashes (a859e2f2, 25d87a73) serve as evidence pointers.
The Böckeler article on TDD in the agent loop is not stored in the repo; ADR 008 cites it by name only.
workflow: Subagent hand-back messages are model output without user authority; their claims need verification before being acted on.
`wc -w` counts differ from the word counts the delegator used (873/774 vs 926/786), so word-count targets should be measured with one tool.

friction: Word-count baselines given to the subagent did not match `wc -w` (873 vs 926 for 007, 774 vs 786 for 008).
ADR 007 stays above the 011-017 length mainly because of its mapping table.
The original ADRs lacked a revisit trigger (007) and an explicit rejected alternative (008), so the subagent had to write them.
open_items: Review the subagent's invented revisit trigger for ADR 007 and keep, change, or remove it.
Review the 'Keep strict test-first for every task' rejected-alternative entry the subagent added to ADR 008.
Decide whether the umbrella-brand bullet in ADR 007, which restates the part ADR-010 superseded, should stay.
The ADR work is committed locally on the worktree branch and not pushed; decide on push or PR.
Consider storing the Böckeler article, or an evidence entry, in the repo since the ADR 008 evidence cites only an external source and a commit hash.
